blindSummary:
This jurisdiction is included in the restive mountain border zone that a foreign interior ministry's country-of-origin note (June 2025) singles out as the exception to its general finding of no state-persecution risk in the country. Foreign travel advisories name it within their highest-warning area for the zone. The enforcement logic is the same as neighbouring jurisdictions in the zone: family-honour norms and informal security structures can produce violence, detention, or forced return without legal process.

No secret-prison infrastructure of the scale documented for one neighbouring jurisdiction, and no explicit special-permission entry requirement, is documented for this jurisdiction specifically. Outside the mountain border zone, the same zone-specific pattern is not documented elsewhere in the country.
